 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. On Friday afternoon, the Boston College men's basketball team plays their second regular season game under new head coach Luke Murray. They will face off against UMass at TD Garden for a all-Massachusetts battle of programs and bragging rights. Join the discussion below!
 Who: Boston College Eagles (1-0) vs Massachusetts Minuetmen (1-0)
 Where: TD Garden, Boston, MA
 When: Friday November 6th, 2026
 Tip-off Time: 4PM ET
 How to Watch: The game will be streamed live on ESPN+
 Go Eagles!
